assets.prompt: Documentary photograph, 16:9, shot from a helicopter with a full-frame camera and telephoto lens, natural colour grading, real-world detail, subtle film grain. White bow wave and long foamy wake, warm orange sunset glow on the horizon, low sea haze. The left third of the frame is open, darker sea. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no hull markings, no people.
